seo.landing_title: Todo — Plan & Act on One Screen
seo.landing_description: All-in-one web workspace: Eisenhower Matrix + Pomodoro Timer. Install the PWA on your phone and get notified when a focus session ends.
seo.login_description: Sign in to Todo to open your Eisenhower matrix, Pomodoro timer, and tasks.
seo.matrix_description: Prioritize tasks in four quadrants and run Pomodoro on the same screen.
seo.todos_description: Manage your task list in Todo.
landing.hero_title: Plan & Act. All on One Screen.
landing.hero_subtitle: Stop jumping between your task list and a separate timer. One web app that puts the Eisenhower Matrix and Pomodoro Timer in a single seamless interface. Prioritize, start the clock, and finish work without taking your eyes off the goal.
landing.hero_promise: Runs in the browser — or install the PWA on your phone to get Pomodoro notifications.
landing.cta_final: Start your first session on the Web
landing.problem_title: Losing focus every time you switch tabs?
landing.problem.item1_desc: Notes in Trello or Notion, then another tab (or your phone) just to run Pomodoro.
landing.problem.item2_desc: Every tab switch to check the next task is a chance to get pulled into Facebook, YouTube, or email.
landing.problem.item3_desc: The timer ends without linking to a completed task, so progress tracking stays vague.
landing.solution_desc: Matrix and timer share the same view — your exclusive all-in-one command center.
landing.solution.matrix_desc: Tasks live in four quadrants — Urgent & Important, Not Urgent but Important, and more. See the full picture even while you work.
landing.solution.pomodoro_desc: No retyping the task name. Pick a task from Important, hit Play, and a focus session runs on the same screen — highlighted so you stay locked in.
landing.solution.deepwork_title: Deep Work Zone on the web
landing.solution.deepwork_desc: Minimalist UI. When the timer runs, noise fades so you focus 100% on the current task in the browser — no heavy desktop install.
landing.why.item1_desc: Open the browser, pin the tab, and you have a command center for the whole day.
landing.why.item2_desc: No extra clicks, no window hopping. Your train of thought stays intact.
landing.why.item3_desc: Ideal for office workers and freelancers who live in the browser eight hours a day — light, visual, always open.
landing.pwa_title: Install like a real app — get Pomodoro notifications
landing.pwa_desc: Todo is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your phone’s home screen, open it full-screen like a native app, and enable Web Push so you’re notified when a focus or break session ends — even if you’re in another app.
landing.pwa.benefit1_desc: No App Store or Play Store. Install from the browser in seconds and open it like its own app.
landing.pwa.benefit2_desc: When a Pomodoro ends, your phone nudges you — even if the tab isn’t open or you’re elsewhere.
landing.pwa.benefit3_desc: Sign in once: your matrix and timer follow you from desktop to phone.
landing.pwa.ios_step1: Open todo.nvnhan0810.com in Safari (on iOS, use Safari — not Chrome).
landing.pwa.ios_step2: Tap Share (the square with an upward arrow).
landing.pwa.ios_step4: Open from the new icon → sign in → open Matrix and enable Web Push.
landing.pwa.ios_video_title: Video: install a PWA on iPhone (Safari → Add to Home Screen)
landing.pwa.android_step2: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right.
landing.pwa.android_step3: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen" → Install.
landing.pwa.android_step4: Open from the icon → sign in → open Matrix and enable Web Push for alerts.
landing.pwa.android_video_title: Video: add a website / PWA to the Android home screen (Chrome)
landing.pwa.noti_note: Important: on iPhone you must open the app from the Home Screen to enable and receive notifications. In Matrix, use "Enable Web Push".
landing.final_title: Don't let scattered tools steal more of your time.
landing.final_desc: One screen. Matrix plus Pomodoro. Install the PWA on your phone so you never miss a notification.
landing.footer_tagline: Eisenhower matrix & Pomodoro — all on one screen
